```{r r-packages}
required_pkgs <- c("gggenomes")
missing_pkgs  <- setdiff(required_pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
```

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(gggenomes)
source("helpers.R")
```

## Inputs

```{r paths}
gene_id      <- params$gene
data_dir     <- file.path("data", gene_id)
genomic_path <- file.path(data_dir, "genomic.fa")
cdna_path    <- file.path(data_dir, "cdna.fa")
guides_path  <- file.path(data_dir, "guides.fa")
sts_path     <- file.path(data_dir, "primer_pairs.sts")
gff_path     <- file.path(data_dir, "gene.gff3")

stopifnot(
  "genomic.fa not found"        = file.exists(genomic_path),
  "cdna.fa not found"           = file.exists(cdna_path),
  "guides.fa not found"         = file.exists(guides_path),
  "primer_pairs.sts not found"  = file.exists(sts_path),
  "gene.gff3 not found"         = file.exists(gff_path)
)
```

## Gene

```{r load-gene}
queries <- parse_fasta(genomic_path)
stopifnot("Expected exactly one record in genomic.fa" = length(queries) == 1)
q <- queries[[1]]
q$gene_name <- gene_id

cdna_records  <- parse_fasta(cdna_path)
guide_records <- parse_fasta(guides_path)
guide_meta    <- parse_oligo_meta(guides_path)
sts_table     <- parse_sts_file(sts_path)
gene_rec      <- read_gene_record(gff_path)

gene_length <- gene_rec$gene_end - gene_rec$gene_start + 1L
padded_len  <- q$length
gene_offset <- (padded_len - gene_length) %/% 2L

meta <- list(
  gene_name    = gene_id,
  chromosome   = gene_rec$chromosome,
  strand       = gene_rec$strand,
  gene_offset  = gene_offset,
  gene_length  = gene_length,
  flank_bp     = gene_offset,
  padded_start = gene_rec$gene_start - gene_offset,
  padded_end   = gene_rec$gene_end   + gene_offset
)

cat(sprintf("Gene:          %s\n", q$gene_name))
cat(sprintf("Locus ID:      %s\n", q$name))
cat(sprintf("Padded length: %d bp\n", q$length))
cat(sprintf("Gene length:   %d bp\n", meta$gene_length))
cat(sprintf("cDNA records:  %d\n", length(cdna_records)))
cat(sprintf("Guides:        %d\n", length(guide_records)))
cat(sprintf("Primer pairs:  %d\n", nrow(sts_table)))
```
